verdict.rationale: A government immigration service could plausibly publish an API or data channel with an OpenAPI spec, XML schemas, or a data dictionary, so the axis applies. The evidence pack covers only human-facing web pages: program information, an eligibility questionnaire, a processing-times checker and account links. Nothing in it documents a machine channel or any machine-readable specification for one.

support.subject: As a developer, a machine-readable specification for the service's machine channel is published — an OpenAPI spec, XML schemas, or a data dictionary
